Subject: Ariba enrollment blocked by MSA redline — SFTP & PO field questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. We're trying to finish Ariba vendor enrollment but Legal at our end hit a snag: your MSA has two redlines around data handling and subcontractor flow-down that our compliance team needs reconciled before we can complete vendor ID verification. We've attached the redline PDF from our counsel.

Separately, our IT team needs clarity on the following items to finalize SFTP EDI drop setup and PO mapping in Ariba:
- SFTP host / username format (we prefer to provision a service account rather than a person)
- Expected PO header fields Redwood requires for automated reconciliation (we saw some differences between your portal matrix and our PO schema)
- Whether Redwood can accept an "alternate invoice id" field (Healthlink sends a legacyAcctId on line-level)

Can someone from Redwood Legal confirm whether the MSA subscriber clause can be adjusted to include a standard subcontractor flow-down and a narrow data-use clause? If Legal needs to talk to our counsel, loop them in — Luke (cc) can coordinate.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Senior Procurement Manager, Healthlink Inc.

Olivia — thanks for the clear summary and the redline PDF. Short answers up front: we can (1) engage Legal immediately on the redlines, (2) provision an SFTP service account for EDI, and (3) map the alternate invoice id to an optional PO line attribute in our ingestion pipeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa (Legal) to review the redlines and propose a narrow compromise language that addresses subcontractor flow-down and limits data use to inference/metrics.
2) Dev (Infra) to share our SFTP provisioning template and the CSV/EDI field mapping matrix.
3) I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Healthlink IT + our infra + legal to align on final wording and portal field acceptance.

Can you do 2pm PT today for a quick call? If not, we can do tomorrow morning.

Action items assigned: Marissa, please confirm you can review the PDF and propose edits by 12:00pm PT today; Dev, please attach the SFTP template and a mocked PO sample back into the thread.

Hi all — I had a quick pass at the Healthlink redlines and attached a clean markup plus a short summary below. My goal: remove blocker language while preserving minimum audit and security obligations.

Summary of proposed edits (high-level):
- Subcontractor flow-down: Acceptable if subcontractors are bound by the same security and confidentiality obligations; propose a capped liability carve-out and explicit limitation to processing for the purposes of inference and service delivery.
- Data handling: Tighten the data use clause to exclude broad analytics for third-party resale; allow telemetry/ops metrics necessary to run service and debug.
- Audit requests: Offer a quarterly SOC attestation + redacted logs rather than ad-hoc full log access.

I've uploaded a redline file: Healthlink_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf (my edits are highlighted). If Healthlink counsel is available, happy to join a three-way call — otherwise, accept my edits as a working compromise and we'll push to final signature via DocuSign.

Also attaching a portal field matrix (portal_field_matrix_v2.xlsx) with the exact field names we will emit on PO payloads and suggested mappings for Healthlink's legacyAcctId -> altInvoiceId. Dev, please add the SFTP credentials template when you post.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Healthlink_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf, portal_field_matrix_v2.xlsx

Hey team — attaching the SFTP provisioning checklist and a minimal credentials template for Healthlink to populate. A few implementation notes:
- We create a single service account (username format: healthlink_hl4521_service) and provide a public key for key-based auth. Password auth is disabled.
- Drop path: /inbound/healthlink/HL-4521/edi/ — please confirm if this needs to be segmented by facility or BU.
- PO payload: We'll accept altInvoiceId as X-ALT-INVOICE-ID in the EDI envelope; portal mapping sheet shows the corresponding field.

If Healthlink can fill the SFTP template and return the public key, we can schedule a handoff to Ariba (they need the vendor ID confirmed before the FTP is hooked into their EDI jobs).

Action: Olivia/Luke — fill sftp_credentials_template.txt and return; Marissa — if the redline file looks good, I'll queue the DocuSign envelope once you confirm the final doc id.

Thanks,
